key_insight: Soft-MoQE learns input-dependent combinations of fixed quantum feature maps, avoiding quantum-parameter optimization while retaining competitive predictive performance.
engineering_relevance: Moving trainable routing to a classical network reduces quantum training cost by orders of magnitude relative to the evaluated trainable quantum neural network.
method: Build a heterogeneous pool of fixed, non-trainable quantum circuits.
Train a classical gating network to weight each circuit’s embedding per input.
Combine weighted embeddings, with class-dependent routing favoring a few experts.
evidence_signal: Across PCA-reduced MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST tasks, Soft-MoQE outperformed the best single expert, uniform expert averaging, and a linear baseline, with task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network.
watch_item: Evaluation on PCA-reduced tasks does not establish scalability, robustness to hardware noise, or an advantage over strong classical models.
paper_title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
